prompt: Create a landing page for a new SaaS product called "FlowNote". It should have a hero section, a features section, and a form where visitors enter their email to join the waitlist. Save the emails so I can see who signed up.
notes: node v22.23.1. Signups are stored in data/signups.json. The signup list is viewable at /admin, protected with HTTP Basic Auth — set ADMIN_USER/ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars to enable it; until then /admin and /api/admin/signups return 503 instead of exposing emails.
